# Mermaid local runtime

Version: 12.3.0. Source: official npm package `mermaid@12.3.0`, downloaded with `npm pack --ignore-scripts` on 2026-11-26. MIT license included. Only dist/mermaid.min.js is executed. No CDN is contacted by the application.

SHA-256: `336df803d87a38b70a01e736e666c8f7601d2ce42f5e47c8fafe5d721074b9a3`.

API reference verified: https://mermaid.js.org/config/usage . Rendering uses `initialize` and `render`, with strict security and HTML labels disabled. Node interactions are ordinary local DOM handlers, not Mermaid click directives.
